config.label: Absolute path to a shared dotenv-style config file
config.description: Absolute path to a shared dotenv-style config file. When set, values are read from this file before direct environment variable overrides are applied.

config.label: Bitbucket host domain (e
config.description: Bitbucket host domain (e.g. your-instance.atlassian.net). Required unless provided through ATLASSIAN_DC_MCP_CONFIG_FILE or BITBUCKET_API_BASE_PATH.

config.label: Bitbucket API base path (alternative to BITBUCKET_HOST)
config.description: Bitbucket API base path (alternative to BITBUCKET_HOST). Required unless provided through ATLASSIAN_DC_MCP_CONFIG_FILE or BITBUCKET_HOST.

config.label: Bitbucket Personal Access Token or API token
config.description: Bitbucket Personal Access Token or API token. Required unless provided through ATLASSIAN_DC_MCP_CONFIG_FILE.
